Ivy (Design): Hey team — design review for the "starter rail" we show in the Console when someone lands after signup. Prototype: https://img.mock/starter-rail-2167.png. Main asks: should the rail be contextual (show recommended sample projects based on repo language) or generic? Also need accessibility and copy suggestions.

Marco (PM): Core goal: reduce time-to-first-success. If we can recommend samples by detected language, we think conversion will be higher. Metric: `starter_rail_sample_selected` within 48h. Can we A/B test localized recommendations vs generic top picks?

Evan (Research): In our last test, participants responded better to personalized suggestions. But risk: misclassification erodes trust. Suggest fallback: show a clear label "Suggested for your stack" so users understand why items appear. Also track `starter_rail_relevance_feedback` clicks.

Priya (A11y): A11y notes: rail uses `role=list` with clickable `role=listitem` cards. Ensure each card has an accessible name (card-title + shortdesc) and a focusable action. Keyboard order should be linear: card1 -> card1 CTA -> card2 -> card2 CTA, etc. Add `aria-describedby` pointing to relevance copy. Also don't rely on color alone for the selected/highlight state.

Sana (Frontend): Implementation notes: we'll render three cards horizontally, responsive to vertical stack on small screens. For keyboard, we'll trap only when rail has explicit focus; otherwise arrow keys won't be hijacked. For personalization, we'll call /api/recommendations?lang=detected; fallback to /api/recommendations?top=3. Analytics events: `starter_rail_impression`, `starter_rail_card_click`, `starter_rail_dismiss`. We'll also include `variant=personalized|generic`.

Ivy (Design): Copy options for CTA on cards: A) `Create from this sample` B) `Use sample` C) `Start with sample`. Leaning A for clarity. Secondary microcopy under the title: "Built with Node.js and Redwood optimized configs" or "Community sample" when generic.

Marco (PM): Good. Rollout plan: start 8% personalized, monitor `starter_rail_reject_rate` (dismiss in <10s) and `sample_created_rate`. If reject_rate > 30% revert.

Priya (A11y): Visual contrast: ensure card label text meets AA on both light and dark themes. Also provide skip link at rail start: `Skip recommended samples` which is visible to keyboard users. For the dismiss control, set `aria-label=\"Dismiss starter suggestions\"`.

Evan (Research): We'll run micro-survey chained to the rail: after dismiss, ask one question: "Was this helpful?" with quick tap options. That gives us `starter_rail_feedback_yes|no`.

Sana (Frontend): Will implement keyboard handlers, aria attributes, and analytics. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for hover/transform animations. Draft PR will include server flag and variant payload.

Ivy (Design): Minor visual tweak: reduce card border radius and increase thumbnail cropping to better show app previews. Updating figma tokens now.

DeployBot: Staging deploy complete (build #4810) — starter rail feature flag default off.

Marco (PM): Please review PR and leave comments by Thursday EOD. We'll enable 8% personalized if Priya signs off on a11y. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
